Allow microphone access?
Meeshy needs access to your microphone for voice messages, video calls, and audio recording.
Microphone access denied
To record voice messages and take part in calls, turn on Microphone for Meeshy in Settings > Permissions.
Microphone denied — tap to open Settings
Allow camera access?
Meeshy needs access to your camera to take photos and videos for messages, video calls, and AR experiences.
Camera access denied
To take photos and videos and start video calls, turn on Camera for Meeshy in Settings > Permissions.
Camera denied — tap to open Settings
Allow access to your photos?
Meeshy needs access to your photo library to share photos and videos with your contacts.
Photo access denied
To pick photos and videos from your library, turn on Photos and videos for Meeshy in Settings > Permissions.
Photo access denied — tap to open Settings
Allow saving to your photos?
Meeshy needs permission to save photos and videos to your library.
Saving to Photos denied
To save photos and videos to your library, turn on Storage for Meeshy in Settings > Permissions.
Saving to Photos denied — tap to open Settings
Allow access to your location?
Meeshy uses your location to share your current location with contacts and find nearby friends.
Location access denied
To share your location and find nearby friends, turn on Location for Meeshy in Settings > Permissions.
Location denied — allow it in Settings
Allow notifications?
Meeshy notifies you of new messages, replies and calls, even when the app is closed.
Notifications are turned off
To be notified of messages and calls, turn on Notifications for Meeshy in Settings.
Notifications off — turn them on in Settings
Allow access to your contacts?
Meeshy uses your contacts to find friends who are already on Meeshy and let you know when one of them joins. No one is contacted on your behalf.
Contacts access denied
To find friends who are already on Meeshy, turn on Contacts for Meeshy in Settings > Permissions.
Contacts denied — allow them in Settings
